d2_answers.question: Separate organic growth from acquisition/consolidation effects.
d2_answers.fact: The Sep-2025 acquisition of the Hulunbuir extreme-testing center was a same-control combination, so historical comparatives were restated. 2025 reported revenue grew 11.72% and adjusted net profit 21.99% on the restated base. 2026 Q1 revenue grew 11.27% and adjusted net profit 75.50% on the restated base, while the company identified smart-connected testing ramp and full consolidation of the extreme-testing center as separate growth drivers.
d2_answers.interpretation: Reported growth still mixes Salt City phase-2 organic ramp with the acquired extreme-testing center. Restatement removes the largest accounting comparability distortion but does not provide a clean entity-level organic bridge.
d2_answers.judgment: PARTIAL_COMPLETE. Organic direction is positive, but exact standalone organic growth is not independently measurable from current public disclosure.

d2_answers.question: Model utilization, pricing, incremental margins and ROIC for new testing capacity.
d2_answers.fact: Company IR disclosed Salt City phase-2 2025 revenue of about RMB68m and profit before tax of about RMB16m, implying an observed PBT margin of about 23.5%. Management explicitly said it could not precisely predict when utilization would reach 70% or 80%. The annual report shows a fixed-asset-heavy cost structure and rising depreciation from new facilities.
d2_answers.interpretation: The new evidence confirms positive economic contribution during ramp and operating leverage potential, but it still does not disclose actual utilization, realized price/mix, or a project-level invested-capital bridge sufficient to calculate mature incremental ROIC.
d2_answers.judgment: BLOCKED_ON_ROIC. This remains the decisive unresolved D2 question; positive 2025 project PBT is insufficient to underwrite mature return on capital.

d2_answers.question: Assess convertible-bond dilution and balance-sheet implications.
d2_answers.fact: The 2026 convertible bond raised RMB1.03904bn gross / RMB1.03048bn net at a RMB5.99 conversion price. Full conversion implies roughly 173.5m new shares, around 13.1% of the pre-conversion share base. The new ice/snow base is planned for construction in 2026-2027, expected usable by end-2027 and formal operation in 2028; company IR states mature annual revenue could reach RMB178m.
d2_answers.interpretation: The bond increases funding runway but introduces material dilution and commits more capital before Salt City phase-2 has demonstrated mature utilization and ROIC.
d2_answers.judgment: COMPLETE. Dilution and capital-allocation execution risk remain material.

d2_answers.question: Map competitive moat and customer concentration.
d2_answers.fact: 2025 field-testing technical services represented RMB553.69m of revenue at 65.25% gross margin. Top-five customers were 57.25% of revenue; controlling shareholder 中汽中心 represented 20.17%. Company facilities span normal-environment, smart-connected and extreme-climate scenarios, with the new ice/snow base intended to complement Salt City.
d2_answers.interpretation: Physical/scenario infrastructure, CATARC ecosystem access and multi-climate coverage form a credible moat, but concentration and related-party demand weaken the independence of market-demand validation.

d2_answers.question: Define valuation ceiling and utilization/ROIC kill conditions.
d2_answers.assumption: Until mature project ROIC is demonstrated, retain the prior conservative research ceiling framework rather than promote to a decision-grade valuation. Any point valuation should be refreshed only with then-current market price and fully diluted share count.
d2_answers.judgment: Kill conditions remain: (1) Salt City utilization/benefits fail to progress after another full operating year; (2) mature after-tax return on major new testing capacity fails to clear an 8-10% research hurdle; (3) customer/related-party concentration rises while third-party growth slows; (4) conversion dilution occurs without proportionate earnings accretion. Current evidence does not prove condition (1), but also does not clear it.

core_investment_judgment_change: NO_UPGRADE. Evidence quality improved; investment conclusion remains HOLD_NOT_DECISION_GRADE.

evidence_gap.missing: Actual Salt City phase-2 utilization, realized pricing/mix and project-level invested-capital/return series sufficient to calculate mature incremental ROIC; equivalent underwriting evidence for the new ice/snow base remains prospective.
evidence_gap.recovery: Auto-revisit on the next H1/H2/annual report or primary IR disclosure that provides utilization, project benefit, price/mix or invested-capital return metrics.
